item.text: I’ll record your approval of the saved result proposal, then continue with the trial’s RoB 2 domain assessments and close the assessment workflow.

Your “Continue” approves the proposed result. I can’t record that approval or proceed with the domain assessments because the RoB 2 tools are no longer available in this session; the approval call failed because the tool was unavailable.
